narrative: A second bill, black-letter, under the first. Title and house and hour. No author's name. No sum on the paper. No face. The servants named, and no figure, and no receipt. The paper is not folded for a pocket.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and stayed at the lodging.

entities.name: The Seven Days of the Week
entities.context: Shown on bill in Seven Days, title only
